table:columns.name: HANDLE
table:columns.description: Zero-padded handle identifier for parcels (official portal field definition for this dataset) — the join key across city parcel data.

table:columns.name: UPDATED
table:columns.description: Date the source snapshot record was updated (portal label 'UPDATED').

table:columns.name: SITEADDR
table:columns.description: Site address of the parcel (portal label).

table:columns.name: OWNERNAME
table:columns.description: Owner name of record (OWNERNAME2 is the overflow line).

table:columns.name: OWNERADDR
table:columns.description: Owner's house number and street name mailing address (portal field definition); OWNERCITY/OWNERSTATE/OWNERZIP/OWNERCNTRY are the rest of the registered mailing address.

table:columns.name: OWNERGROUP
table:columns.description: Owner grouping assigned in the source extract (portal label only; no decode published).

table:columns.name: NUMUNITS
table:columns.description: Number of units on the parcel (portal label).

table:columns.name: ZONING1
table:columns.description: Zoning district code decoded by the city's 'Zoning Code' vocabulary (ZONING2-3 are additional districts where the parcel spans zones).

table:columns.name: VACANTLAND
table:columns.description: Vacant-land flag, 'Y' or 'N' (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: ASMTLAND
table:columns.description: Assessment (assessed value) of land in dollars (portal label 'Assessment Land').

table:columns.name: ASMTIMPROV
table:columns.description: Assessment of improvements in dollars (portal label 'Assessment Improvements').

table:columns.name: ASMTTOTAL
table:columns.description: Total assessed value in dollars (portal label 'Assessment Total').

table:columns.name: LANDUSE1
table:columns.description: Land-use code decoded by the city's official 'Assessor Land Use' vocabulary, e.g. 1110 Single Family Units, 1010 Vacant Residential Lot (LANDUSE2-4 are additional codes; the portal maps these columns to that vocabulary).

table:columns.name: ASRUSE1
table:columns.description: Assessor use code (portal label 'Assessor Use Code'); the portal publishes no decode vocabulary for this column (ASRUSE2-4 likewise).

table:columns.name: ASRCLASS1
table:columns.description: Assessor class code — owner-type classification, decoded by the city's 'Assessor Class Code' vocabulary (ASRCLASS2-4 are additional codes).

table:columns.name: LEGAL1
table:columns.description: First line of the legal description (LEGAL2-5 continue it; portal labels 'Legal Description').

table:columns.name: NUMBLDGS
table:columns.description: Number of buildings on the parcel (portal label).

table:columns.name: LANDAREA
table:columns.description: Lot area in square feet (portal label 'Land Area'; units per the current parcels extract where values match polygon areas in feet).

table:columns.name: FRONTAGE
table:columns.description: Street frontage in feet (portal label 'Frontage').

table:columns.name: DAILYDATE
table:columns.description: Recorder of Deeds daily-record date of the latest recorded instrument (portal label 'Daily Date'); DAILYNUM, BOOKNUM and BOOKPAGE are the daily number and deed book/page references.

table:columns.name: BDG1YEAR
table:columns.description: Year built of building 1 (portal label 'Building 1 Year'); BDG1AREA is its area and BDG1EXWALL its exterior-wall code.

table:columns.name: CITYBLOCK
table:columns.description: City block number of the parcel key; PARCEL is the parcel number within the block.

table:columns.name: NBRHD
table:columns.description: City neighborhood number (city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: PARCEL10
table:columns.description: Ten-digit parcel identifier (CityBlock+Parcel+OwnerCode form; see the legacy BBBBbbPPPO schema); PARCEL9 is the nine-digit CityBlock+Parcel root.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>

table:columns.name: era
table:columns.description: Snapshot vintage added by this mirror: which yearly source extract (1997-2015 single years, plus a combined 2016-2020 file) the row came from.

table:columns.name: OWNEROCC
table:columns.description: Owner-occupancy dwelling-type code: 1 Single Family, 2 Two-Family, 4 Three-or-Four Family, 5 Five-plus Family, C Condo, X Other (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerOccCode).

table:columns.name: VACBLDGYR
table:columns.description: Year the property entered the vacant building registry (name-based).

table:columns.name: ASRNBRHD
table:columns.description: Assessor's assessment-neighborhood number.

styles/default.title: Parcels by era
styles/default.description: Five-year snapshots of the city's parcel boundaries (the map shows 1997, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2016-2020; the full Parquet holds every yearly snapshot, 3.1M rows).

styles/style-1997.title: Parcels in 1997
styles/style-1997.description: The oldest snapshot alone — compare against the current parcels collection to see consolidation and demolition.

styles/style-2020.title: Parcels in 2016-2020
styles/style-2020.description: The newest snapshot in the archive (published as a single 2016-2020 era file).

thumbnail.title: Parcels (Historical, 1997-2020) rendered with the default style

styles/style-zoning-1997.title: Zoning in 1997
styles/style-zoning-1997.description: Each 1997 parcel filled by its zoning letter — compare with the current parcels collection's zoning view to see three decades of rezoning.
